camera.py.description: Streams a USB or Pi camera to the Camera page (pick the source in the dropdown).

cam_test.py.description: Grabs one picamzero frame and writes it to /home/bdxv2/aze.jpg — quick camera check.

v2_rl_walk_mujoco.py.description: Open Duck Mini RL walk policy on the real servos. Edit args below if the ONNX model lives elsewhere.

turn_on.py.description: Torque-enables every servo and holds the current position.

turn_off.py.description: Torque-disables every servo — the robot goes limp, so support it first.

check_motors.py.description: Pings every joint id and reports which servos answer on the bus.

check_voltage.py.description: Prints per-servo bus voltage through pypot Feetech IO.

check_volt_gui.py.description: Serves its own NiceGUI page with live voltage plots — opens a separate web port.

configure_motor.py.description: Assigns an id to a brand new servo. Needs --id (and optionally --port).

configure_all_motors.py.description: Writes the standard PID/limits to every joint id in one pass.

find_soft_offsets.py.description: Moves the robot to zero position to measure joint offsets — needs a keypress, hold the robot.

head_puppet.py.description: Init pose, then drive the head with an Xbox controller.

antennas_controller_test.py.description: Maps the Xbox triggers to the two antenna servos.

calibrate_imu.py.description: Runs the BNO055 calibration routine and stores the result.

imu_server.py.description: Publishes IMU samples over TCP port 1234 for imu_client.py on a laptop.

imu_client.py.description: Desktop-side viewer for imu_server.py — needs FramesViewer and a display.

record_data.py.description: Sweeps kp/kd/acceleration on one servo and pickles the response.

new_record_data.py.description: Same sweep as record_data.py with the --new_firmware load conversion.

plot_recorded_data.py.description: Matplotlib plots of a recorded pickle — needs -f FILE and a display.

fc_test.py.description: OpenAI function-calling loop driving walk + camera. Needs an API key and the ONNX model.
